findings.title: Diff trimming can throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException
findings.body: In VerifyMessageProperties.verifySafeHtml the code trims common prefix (start) and suffix (end) and then does value.substring(start, value.length() - end). start is bounded by min length and end is bounded by min length independently, so start+end can exceed the string length when one string is a repetition/prefix of the other, e.g. value="a" vs sanitized="aaa" gives start=1, end=1 and substring(1,0). Someone reading only this finds the verifier itself can crash instead of reporting Illegal HTML.

findings.title: Anchor stripping iterates stale Matcher after mutating value
findings.body: santizeAnchors creates Matcher on the original value then mutates value with replaceFirst inside the while(matcher.find()) loop. After the first removal the Matcher positions no longer correspond to the new string, so with two or more <a> tags the second tag can be skipped, double-counted, or the wrong occurrence removed via replaceFirst. This lets mismatched/translated anchors pass or produces false Didn't find anchor tag errors.

findings.title: English reference lookup is fragile and aborts on RuntimeException
findings.body: englishFile is built with replaceAll("resources-community","resources").replaceAll("_[a-zA-Z-_]*\\.properties","_en.properties"). The second replaceAll replaces every match, not just the locale suffix, so any underscore in a directory/file prefix corrupts the path, and failures are thrown as RuntimeException which aborts the whole verification instead of reporting a file error. Someone reading only this understands a translated file can break the build or be compared against the wrong English source.

findings.title: Lithuanian translation replaced with Italian text
findings.body: This PR replaces totpStep1 containing <a> tags with "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:" which is Italian, not Lithuanian, in a messages_lt.properties file. The same Italian sentence is also used for login/messages/messages_lt.properties. Merging this ships the wrong language to Lithuanian users; it should be Lithuanian or the English fallback.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese file gets Traditional Chinese text
findings.body: The replacement totpStep1 in messages_zh_CN.properties is "在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一:" which uses Traditional characters, while the file is Simplified Chinese (zh_CN). Merging this introduces a locale inconsistency for Simplified Chinese users.
